svg.title: Early signs of autism in young children
svg.desc: Six illustrated cards showing early autism signs to watch for in children ages 12 to 36 months, with bilingual English and Chinese labels.
svg.text: Early signs to watch for · 需注意的早期迹象
These signs do not confirm autism — ask your pediatrician about a screening · 如有疑虑，请咨询儿科医生
